scope: Two coplanar deformable strips joined at a zero-offset seam. Pure tangential separation and low-load normal bending only; not a physical lap rivet or mixed-mode aircraft joint.

geometry.classification: Own verification geometry; coplanar seam replaces physical lap offset and excludes contact.

material.classification: Generic constant elastic aluminum-like reference, not a Boeing material card; no plasticity or shell fracture.

joint.property: TYPE8 H2, zero length, fixed local frame, no rotational stiffness, only tested loading component active
joint.source: I02B source-envelope transcription and D-squared assumption retained; all postpeak displacements remain hypotheses

boundary: Across-width strain suppressed. Shear: only longitudinal translations free, all rotations constrained. Normal: only transverse translations and bending rotations free, far-end rotations clamped. Not a freely deforming aircraft joint.
accepted_revision: R1: LAW1 shell global through-thickness integration N=0 specified explicitly. R0 retained. Warning 445 NULL INERTIA allowed only for zero-mass, zero-rotational-stiffness seam; no other warning accepted. Shell nodal inertia remains present. Read-back audit uses the predeclared 2 percent momentum gate also for independent nodal momentum, replacing an unconfigured extra 1e-5 diagnostic that rejected a 0.0225 percent discrepancy in the initial audit; no solver input changed for that correction.
audit_correction: Independent nodal kinetic energy likewise uses the configured 1 percent energy gate; an extra unconfigured 1e-5 diagnostic rejected 1.84e-5 relative in the first coarse separation audit. Initial failed audit files retained. Time-staggered kinetic quantities are reported explicitly; no physical parameter or configured tolerance was adjusted.
revision_R2: Add 1e-8 relative padding to unloading K only, avoiding roundoff-triggered automatic slope correction warning 506 on fractional tributary weights. Input curve peaks and G unchanged. Rejected R1 normal/fine cases preserved. Mass-scaling diagnostic uses the configured relative mass tolerance rather than exact floating zero (1.8e-15 g roundoff observed).
revision_R3: One-sided-law domain enforcement: the long R2 low-energy and high-G dynamic runs cross to negative slip at 0.0332 and 0.22055 ms, hence are not accepted full trajectories. New dynamic cases stop at 0.032 and 0.21 ms. The R2 cycle minimum slip -0.001045 mm is rejected; R3 unloads the grip to +0.05 mm, inside its unloaded slack region. Numerical negative-slip tolerance is 1e-5 mm; no compression/reverse shear capacity or contact is credited.
